movies.title: You Can See Everything
movies.description: Nathan Fielder and Elizabeth Holmes collide in A24's mind-bending $100M box-office documentary sensation.
movies.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.description: Christopher Nolan's $1.8 billion Homeric epic finally lands on digital with massive home scale.
movies.overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

movies.title: Possible Love
movies.description: Lee Chang-dong's Venice Grand Jury Prize winner brings devastating Korean drama straight to Netflix.
movies.overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

movies.title: Fjord
movies.description: Palme d'Or winner starring Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve unpacks an unforgettable moral storm.
movies.overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start. But the fragile peace begins to unravel when the Gheorghiu family’s young daughter, Elia, arrives at school covered in bruises.

movies.title: Steps
movies.description: Cinderella's stepsisters steal the spotlight in this witty animated hit topping Netflix charts.
movies.overview: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Tom Holland's $2.5 billion webslinger smash hits home screens with bruised, street-level heart.
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: The Shadow's Edge
movies.description: Jackie Chan brings bruised, old-school practical stunts back to Macau's high-stakes crime thriller.
movies.overview: Macau Police brings the tracking expert police officer out of retirement to help catch a dangerous group of professional thieves.
production_companies: iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）

movies.title: Heart of the Beast
movies.description: Brad Pitt and a battle-scarred combat dog trek through brutal Alaskan wilderness survival.
movies.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

movies.title: Guarding Stars
movies.description: Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki charm audiences in Netflix's chart-topping holiday bodyguard rom-com.
movies.overview: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays, sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

movies.title: Heartland
movies.description: Jessica Chastain goes full country noir in this soapy Nashville mystery lighting up Netflix.
movies.overview: Former country music legend Misty Jones returns to Nashville to unravel the truth behind her rising-star niece's disappearance.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.description: Rescued from the vault, Wile E. Coyote's courtroom comedy became an unlikely $120M triumph.
movies.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

movies.title: The Holy Boy
movies.description: Can a teenager's hug heal grief? Fantastic Fest's unsettling Italian folk horror arrives today.
movies.overview: A PE teacher moves to a isolated mountain village where the people appear to live in unshakeable serenity, but soon stumbles across a disturbing ritual. Once a week, the locals are freed of their pain by a lonely boy born with the power to heal one's soul just by hugging them. Trying to rescue him from this madness, the man unleashes his dark side.

movies.title: Forgotten Island
movies.description: Vibrant Filipino folklore adventure from DreamWorks that earned glowing reviews and awards buzz.
movies.overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.description: Daisy Edgar-Jones anchors a fresh, sunlit take on Jane Austen's beloved sisterhood classic.
movies.overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

movies.title: Tony
movies.description: Dominic Sessa channels young Anthony Bourdain in A24's rowdy kitchen biopic on HBO Max.
movies.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

movies.title: Primetime
movies.description: Robert Pattinson plays Chris Hansen in A24's eerie, stylish media-ethics thriller.
movies.overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

movies.title: Tenzing
movies.description: Tom Hiddleston and Willem Dafoe join an inspiring Everest ascent streaming on Apple TV.
movies.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

movies.title: The Invite
movies.description: Olivia Wilde and Seth Rogen's razor-sharp dinner party comedy now streams on HBO Max.
movies.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

movies.title: A Story of Derry
movies.description: HBO Max's surprise Halloween prequel special digs centuries deep into Derry's ancient evil.
movies.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.

movies.title: Drive - The Pretenders
movies.description: German fake-engagement racing romance shifts into high gear on Prime Video.
movies.overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

movies.title: De Gaulle: Résistance
movies.description: Sweeping French WWII drama captures Charles de Gaulle's defiant 1940 flight to London.
movies.overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.description: Woody and Buzz battle high-tech playtime in Pixar's billion-dollar sequel streaming on Disney Plus.
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: Doing Life
movies.description: Tyler Perry delivers heartfelt redemption romance through prison letters on Netflix.
movies.overview: A single mother and an incarcerated man forge an unlikely bond through heartfelt letters, unlocking a door to redemption, hope and love against all odds.

movies.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movies.description: Hannah Einbinder and Gillian Anderson headline Jane Schoenbrun's surreal slasher satire on MUBI.
movies.overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

movies.title: The Social Reckoning
movies.description: Aaron Sorkin reunites with Jeremy Strong for a brisk Facebook whistleblower drama.
movies.overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

movies.title: Hope
movies.description: Na Hong-jin follows The Wailing with a bonkers, blood-soaked Korean monster-action spectacle.
movies.overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

movies.title: Runner
movies.description: Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson dodge cartels in a fast-paced Hulu action comedy.
movies.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
movies.description: Gotham burns as Arkham's worst escape in this gritty animated Batman adaptation.
movies.overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

movies.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
movies.description: Spanish zombie survival action escalates fast in this Prime Video sequel.
movies.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

movies.title: Buddy
movies.description: Too Many Cooks creator unleashes Keegan-Michael Key as an unhinged kids-show unicorn.
movies.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.description: Sixth chapter of the hit horror franchise brings demonic thrills early to Netflix.
movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

movies.title: Animals
movies.description: Ben Affleck directs and stars in a messy but star-packed Netflix kidnapping thriller.
movies.overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.description: Lili Reinhart leads a charming fake-dating academic rom-com streaming on Prime Video.
movies.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

movies.title: Surviving Hurricane Otis
movies.description: Estranged brothers battle Acapulco's devastating storm in this earnest Netflix survival drama.
movies.overview: Two estranged brothers struggle to survive Hurricane Otis in Acapulco, where their bond and courage turn adversity into hope.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.description: Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor face suburban cosmic dread from director David Robert Mitchell.
movies.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: The Weight
movies.description: Ethan Hawke and Russell Crowe face off in a gritty prison gold-smuggling thriller.
movies.overview: When Samuel is torn from his daughter and sent to a brutal prison, Warden Clancy offers him a high-stakes proposition: smuggle gold out of a remote mine with a dangerous crew of prisoners and he’ll win his freedom.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.description: Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh headline a breezy Cold War buddy caper on Apple TV.
movies.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

movies.title: The Room Next Door
movies.description: Julianne Moore and Tilda Swinton shine in Pedro Almodóvar's moving drama on Hulu.
movies.overview: Ingrid and Martha were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

movies.title: Collision Course
movies.description: A botched heist sparks dangerous betrayals in this tense Spanish thriller on Netflix.
movies.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

movies.title: Love of Your Life
movies.description: Margaret Qualley brings quiet ache to a sweeping romance streaming on Prime Video.
movies.overview: After a chance encounter sparks a sweeping romance, Maya's future is suddenly upended, sending her on an unexpected journey to love and live again.

movies.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
movies.description: Matthew McConaughey and Kurt Russell anchor a soulful, bluegrass-infused Oklahoma crime drama.
movies.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

movies.title: Minions & Monsters
movies.description: Pierre Coffin's Illumination juggernaut unleashes Hollywood monster chaos for family movie night.
movies.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.description: Andrew Garfield leads Paul Greengrass's gritty 14th-century English rebellion on Peacock.
movies.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

movies.title: The Cycle
movies.description: Deborah Ann Woll unearths dark family secrets in Shudder's moody murder mystery.
movies.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

movies.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
movies.description: Nicola Coughlan brings whimsical Enid Blyton magic to family movie night.
movies.overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

movies.title: Don't Say Good Luck
movies.description: Sunny Sandler and Melanie Lynskey balance high school theater with family chaos on Netflix.
movies.overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

movies.title: Facing El Chapo
movies.description: Two Mexican officers fight to survive one brutal shift against a cartel boss.
movies.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

movies.title: The Second Act
movies.description: Léa Seydoux and Louis Garrel deadpan through Quentin Dupieux's breezy French meta-comedy.
movies.overview: Florence wants to introduce David, the man she’s madly in love with, to her father Guillaume. But David isn’t attracted to Florence and wants to throw her into the arms of his friend Willy. The four characters meet in a restaurant in the middle of nowhere.

movies.title: Finding Emily
movies.description: Angourie Rice sparks a lively British campus rom-com streaming on Peacock.
movies.overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

movies.title: Fuze
movies.description: Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Theo James race an unexploded WWII bomb in central London.
movies.overview: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.description: Jason Statham boards a cargo ship for one-man maritime vengeance.
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: The Dog Stars
movies.description: Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin weather the apocalypse in Ridley Scott's moody survival tale.
movies.overview: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

movies.title: Jackass: Best and Last
movies.description: Johnny Knoxville and crew pull off one final, painful victory lap on Paramount Plus.
movies.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.description: Zach Cregger turns Raccoon City into a wild, $416M survival-horror joyride.
movies.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.description: Grief turns monstrous in this gnarly franchise horror entry streaming on HBO Max.
movies.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

movies.title: I Want Your Sex
movies.description: Gregg Araki pairs Olivia Wilde and Cooper Hoffman in a provocative art-world thriller.
movies.overview: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

movies.title: Motor City
movies.description: Alan Ritchson seeks 1970s Detroit vengeance in a pulpy thriller on Prime Video.
movies.overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

movies.title: Other Mommy
movies.description: Jessica Chastain pulls double duty in a slick, jump-scare Blumhouse box-office hit.
movies.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.

movies.title: Verity
movies.description: Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson headline Colleen Hoover's campy, divisive lakeside thriller.
movies.overview: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.

movies.title: Moana
movies.description: Dwayne Johnson returns for Disney's live-action island voyage now streaming on Disney Plus.
movies.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.
